findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: the four a.cta elements have no href (cursor:pointer only); focus.json is empty and the sweep reports 'Tab reached no focusable element'. The links look actionable but cannot be reached or activated by keyboard.
findings.after: … with a real destination, or remove the link styling if there is nowhere to go.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.1.1 Keyboard: every function available by pointer must be available by keyboard.

findings.evidence: Four links share the accessible name '了解更多 →' ('learn more'); read out of context (link list) they are indistinguishable.
findings.after: Name the target in the link or via aria-describedby pointing at the card heading, e.g. '了解产地 →', or aria-label="了解更多：第一步 产地".
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context): identical names for different destinations.

findings.evidence: At 375 the three-column grid holds: card text wraps every 2-3 characters and '了解更多 →' breaks over three lines; card three runs to the right edge (x 266-366). Content is technically present but unreadable as running text.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.10 Reflow: content at 320 CSS px must be usable without loss of readability.

findings.where: links and numbers on white cards
findings.evidence: Links are distinguished only by #d97757 with text-decoration:none; standing alone in cards this is acceptable for 1.4.1, but the same colour fails 4.5:1 on white (3.12:1, sweep). Verified on tile 1440-00: the orange '了解更多' is visibly light.
findings.after: Darken the accent-ink to about #a8492c (≥4.5:1 on #fff) and underline on hover/focus.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); confirms sweep hit as real.

strengths: No motion, no hidden content: all 210 characters visible under reduced motion, without observers and without scripts (hidden.json).
